description: This file defines an interface IRelationalStorage for interacting with relational databases, including methods for executing queries and commands asynchronously, and properties for database identification. It is part of a namespace that varies based on compilation symbols, indicating different contexts such as clustering, persistence, reminders, streaming, grain directory, or testing utilities.

classes.name: IRelationalStorage
classes.description: An interface for executing database operations asynchronously, including reading data and executing commands, with properties for database identification.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a query that returns a collection of TResult, transforming each IDataRecord into TResult using a provided selector function.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a non-query command such as INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL, returning the number of affected rows.
